title: Young, Beginning and Small Farmer Program Statement — Land Rate Discount on the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans)
content:
**Program statement.** When automatic debit is authorised on a FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage (Farm Real Estate Loans), the young-farmer land discount follows the member's StartRight Operating Line, a product of Operating Lines of Credit: when it is in active status and the farm real estate loan closed less than 60 months ago, the discount is the product's young-farmer land discount; when it is in active status and the loan closed 60 or more months ago, the discount is 0.25 percentage points; otherwise there is none.

**What the records show.** On the member's Operating Lines of Credit records, a line on the StartRight Operating Line product and its status; on the farm real estate loan, its closing date, from which the months since closing are counted to the day the rate is set.

## Discount ladder

| StartRight Operating Line in active status | Months since the farm real estate loan closed | Young-farmer land discount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | fewer than 60 | the product's young-farmer land discount |
| yes | 60 or more | 0.25 percentage points |
| no | any | none |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Active StartRight line, loan closed 59 months ago: the product's young-farmer land discount.
- Active StartRight line, loan closed exactly 60 months ago: 0.25 percentage points.
- StartRight line closed or matured, any loan age: no young-farmer land discount.
